# Kshitij Mathur

> I'm Kshitij Mathur, a product designer and engineer from India, studying Computer Science at SKIT Jaipur. I build real-time web apps, ML-backed tools and products people can use the same day.

Kshitij Mathur is based in Jaipur, India. Education: B.Tech CSE · SKIT Jaipur · CGPA 9.0. Status: Open to projects & collaborations.

## Projects

- [Meetly](https://meetly-beta.vercel.app): Video meetings with games. A browser-based video meeting app for small groups: calls for up to six people, screen sharing, chat and five multiplayer games, with nothing to install. Stack: React 19, Vite, WebRTC, Socket.io, Node.js, Express 5, MongoDB, Vercel, Render. Code: https://github.com/Kmathur08/Meetly
- [Thandak](https://thandak-india-api.vercel.app): Heat safety for India. A free heat-safety service in Hindi and English that tells a family how risky today's heat is and what to do, on the web, Android, iOS and WhatsApp. Stack: Python, XGBoost, JavaScript, Java, Swift, Docker, WhatsApp bot, Vercel. Code: https://github.com/VanshikaSingh277/garmi-check-india
- **PaperSetu**: Exam papers for teachers. An offline Android app for school teachers, in Hindi and English, that builds exam question papers in minutes and exports print-ready PDFs. Stack: Kotlin, Android WebView, JavaScript, Firebase, Firestore, Cloudflare Workers, Gemini API, Brevo.
- [PrepWise](https://github.com/Kmathur08/PrepWise): AI mock interview platform. Upload your resume and an AI voice agent interviews you for the role, then scores every answer and shows where you are weak. Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Vapi AI, Google Gemini, Firebase Auth, Firestore, Mammoth. Code: https://github.com/Kmathur08/PrepWise
- [RDIS LMS](https://rdis-lms.vercel.app/): Gamified learning platform. A learning management system for courses, lessons and quizzes, with XP, badges, streaks and leaderboards to keep students coming back. Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, JWT, Vercel. Code: https://github.com/krishnaw17/SKIT-CSE-2023-2027-48

## Experience

- B.Tech CSE, SKIT (Sep 2023): Computer Science at SKIT Jaipur, CGPA 9.0. Coordinator of the Science & Technology Club.
- Web Dev Intern (Jul – Aug 2024): Kistechno Software, Jaipur. Built and shipped a responsive site with lazy loading and minified assets.
- Front-end Intern (Jun – Jul 2025): PRNIT India LLP, Jaipur. 10+ reusable React and Tailwind components, two client features shipped on time.
- Gen AI Intern (May – Jul 2026): MNIT Jaipur. Hybrid candidate-ranking pipeline with reranking and honeypot detection for the RedRob AI Hackathon.
- Shipping & practising (Now): Meetly, PaperSetu and Thandak this autumn, problems most days, open to internships.

## Skills

C++, Java, React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Express, Socket.io, WebRTC, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Python, scikit-learn, XGBoost, Tailwind, Firebase, Docker, Gemini API, Vapi, Git, Postman, Figma, Vercel

## Services

- Full-stack web apps: From a rough idea to a deployed app: data model, API, auth and a polished interface, shipped to Vercel or Render with a link you can share the same week.
- Real-time & collaborative: Video calls, live chat, multiplayer games and shared boards. I built Meetly end to end, so I know where peer-to-peer connections break and how to keep game state honest.
- Data & ML features: Practical machine learning inside real products: ranking, record matching and estimates that show their uncertainty, backed by Python services and clear data pipelines.
- Product design & UI: Flows, interfaces and motion designed by the person who will build them, so what you approve in the design is what ships.
